text: 阿塞拜疆总统阿利耶夫14日在巴库会见中共中央政治局委员、外交部长王毅。中方祝贺阿方在阿利耶夫总统领导下国家建设事业蒸蒸日上，支持阿方走符合本国国情的发展道路，愿与阿方等各方加强中间运输走廊合作，继续成为阿方发展进程中可信赖的长期战略伙伴。中方感谢阿方长期以来在涉及中方核心利益问题上给予的有力支持，也支持阿方维护独立、主权和领土完整。中国的发展是全球南方力量的增强和发展中国家力量的壮大，中方愿同阿方继续紧密协调合作，维护好全球南方国家的共同利益。中方支持阿方在亚信等多边平台及国际事务中发挥重要作用，为地区和世界的和平稳定作出更多贡献。（央视新闻）
text_en: Azerbaijani President Aliyev met in Baku on the 14th with Wang Yi, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Foreign Minister. The Chinese side congratulated Azerbaijan on its flourishing national development cause under President Aliyev's leadership, supported Azerbaijan in following a development path suited to its national conditions, and is willing to strengthen Middle Corridor cooperation with Azerbaijan and other parties and continue to be a trustworthy long-term strategic partner in Azerbaijan's development process. The Chinese side thanked Azerbaijan for its long-standing strong support on issues involving China's core interests and also supports Azerbaijan in safeguarding independence, sovereignty and territorial integrity. China's development is an enhancement of the strength of the Global South and the growth of developing countries, and China is willing to continue close coordination and cooperation with Azerbaijan to safeguard the common interests of Global South countries. The Chinese side supports Azerbaijan in playing an important role in multilateral platforms such as CICA and in international affairs, and in making more contributions to regional and world peace and stability. (CCTV News)
